title: 离线GCS删除计划：到期且无hold才列入，携带精确generation防止误删新版本
answer:
```python
import datetime
def deletion_plan(objects,now):
    current=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(now.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    if current.tzinfo is None:raise ValueError('aware time required')
    plan=[];seen=set()
    for item in objects:
        if not isinstance(item.get('name'),str) or not item['name'] or not isinstance(item.get('generation'),str) or not item['generation'].isascii() or not item['generation'].isdigit() or int(item['generation'])<=0 or any(type(item.get(key)) is not bool for key in ('temporaryHold','eventBasedHold')):raise ValueError('finite object metadata')
        identity=(item['name'],item['generation'])
        if identity in seen:raise ValueError('duplicate object generation')
        seen.add(identity)
        expiry=item.get('retentionExpirationTime')
        if expiry is not None:
            expiry=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(expiry.replace('Z','+00:00'))
            if expiry.tzinfo is None:raise ValueError('aware retention deadline')
        if item['temporaryHold'] or item['eventBasedHold'] or expiry is not None and current<expiry:continue
        plan.append({'name':item['name'],'ifGenerationMatch':item['generation']})
    return plan
```

原题知识说明：
桌面推演，未在生产执行。检查错误中的retentionPolicyNotMet、对象保留到期时间及桶策略isLocked，确认IAM允许但保留锁阻止删除。锁定策略不能缩短或移除，恢复方案是停止无效重试、等待合法到期并调整清理计划，不建议删桶绕过。验收到期前拒绝和到期后允许均符合策略，核算暂存成本。

body:
## 操作任务
实现 deletion_plan(objects,now)。对象归一化记录含name、正数字符串generation、两个严格bool字段temporaryHold/eventBasedHold及可空retentionExpirationTime；now/到期时间须为带时区ISO时间。未到期或任意hold的对象不列入，恰到期可列；返回按输入顺序的name/ifGenerationMatch计划，拒绝重复同一对象代次，不修改元数据或实际删除对象。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；本地文件/数据库及离线Google Cloud有限模型，不访问云API。

## 能力边界
本地保留期限/hold/代次计划模型，不发GCS删除请求，不解除锁，不计算完整bucket/object保留策略，也不计作真实云恢复验收。

import os,sys,pathlib,secrets,json,copy,sqlite3,tempfile,subprocess,base64,hashlib,datetime,re
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('OFFLINE_CLOUD_SCOPE:NO_CLOUD_API_REQUESTS',flush=True)
def student(function,*args):
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+function.__name__,flush=True)
 try:return function(*args)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('offline GCP contract failed') from error
base={'name':'logs/due','generation':'42','temporaryHold':False,'eventBasedHold':False,'retentionExpirationTime':'2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'}
future=copy.deepcopy(base);future.update(name='logs/not-due',generation='43',retentionExpirationTime='2026-11-02T00:00:00Z')
held=copy.deepcopy(base);held.update(name='logs/held',generation='44',temporaryHold=True)
event_held=copy.deepcopy(base);event_held.update(name='logs/event-held',generation='45',eventBasedHold=True)
items=[base,future,held,event_held];before=copy.deepcopy(items)
assert student(task.deletion_plan,items,'2026-11-01T08:00:00+08:00')==[{'name':'logs/due','ifGenerationMatch':'42'}],'IAM deletion permission was mistaken for bypassing retention/holds or generation safety'
assert task.deletion_plan(items,'2026-10-31T23:59:59Z')==[]
assert items==before
try:task.deletion_plan(items,'2026-11-01T00:00:00')
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('naive time accepted')

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

# Exact normalized-metadata contract, including validation and no mutation.
free=dict(base,name='free',generation='0009',retentionExpirationTime=None)
other=dict(free,generation='10')
assert task.deletion_plan([free,other],'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')==[{'name':'free','ifGenerationMatch':'0009'},{'name':'free','ifGenerationMatch':'10'}]
assert task.deletion_plan([],'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')==[]
assert task.deletion_plan([base],'2026-10-31T20:00:00-04:00')==[{'name':base['name'],'ifGenerationMatch':base['generation']}]
for invalid in [dict(free,generation='0'),dict(free,generation='-1'),dict(free,generation=9),dict(free,generation='٩'),dict(free,temporaryHold=0),dict(free,eventBasedHold='false'),dict(free,name=''),dict(free,retentionExpirationTime='2026-01-01T00:00:00')]:
 snapshot=copy.deepcopy(invalid)
 try:task.deletion_plan([invalid],'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('invalid metadata accepted')
 assert invalid==snapshot
try:task.deletion_plan([free,copy.deepcopy(free)],'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('duplicate identity accepted')

title: 本地GCS下载完整性：真实计算CRC32C，兼容无MD5的compose对象
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Google Cloud官方文档核对
review_note: 会话04作者补强离线原题边界；真实本地Python原生验证另附，独审待调度，不声明云端原故障恢复。
body:
## 操作任务
实现 verify_download(path,metadata)。metadata含十进制字符串size及base64大端4字节crc32c，可选base64的16字节md5Hash。流式读取实际本地文件，核对长度、Castagnoli CRC32C（不是zlib CRC32）及存在时的MD5；MD5缺失不应拒绝只要CRC32C/长度正确。失败ValueError，不修改文件，成功返回bytes/crc32c/md5_verified。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；本地文件/数据库及离线Google Cloud有限模型，不访问云API。

## 能力边界
真实本地字节校验与GCS元数据格式子集，不下载或compose真实对象；校验和不是来源认证，不证明传输权限或真实云故障已恢复。
